Three cases: (1) no file has more calls than its baseline, and no file outside the baseline has any, with the message 'the action refreshes; a client part does not call router.refresh() after a server action (docs/rules/admin/platform.md)'; (2) no baseline entry is higher than the real count (so the baseline must be lowered in the same commit that removes a call); (3) the total equals the sum of the baseline. Under the heading that starts '## Server actions run through `storeAction()` / `platformAction()`' add one bullet after the existing one: '- The action refreshes; a client part does not. An action that changes what the route shows calls `refresh()` (or `redirect()`), and its answer already carries the route drawn again, so the client never calls `router.refresh()` after it (that draws every layout and the page a second time). `router.refresh()` stays only where no action refreshed: a poll, a fetch to a route handler, an action that by design does not refresh. `src/components/admin/router-refresh.scan.test.ts` holds the count per file, which may only fall.' Wrap at the file's line width.
